Submit_report: The prod pgbouncer connection pool was exhausted due to a worker throughput of 0, but restarting the service cleared the pool. The failed-jobs backlog in the jobs database has 1388 failed jobs, with 47 of them being malformed rows. The export of the failed_jobs table for the postmortem has been completed. The next step would be to investigate the root cause of the worker throughput being 0 and resolve the issue to prevent future failures.
